definitions.explanation: The eggs of fish, used as a general term covering all varieties including salmon roe, cod roe, herring roe, and others.

examples.japanese: {魚卵|ぎょらん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Fish roe is high in salt content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{魚卵|ぎょらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, there are many dishes that use fish roe.

examples.japanese: {魚卵|ぎょらん}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、いくら⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I have a fish roe allergy, so I can't eat salmon roe or mentaiko.

notes:
{魚卵|ぎょらん} is the general term for fish eggs of any kind. It is used in formal, scientific, or culinary contexts when referring to fish roe as a category rather than a specific type.

SPECIFIC TYPES:
- いくら: salmon roe (large, red, loose eggs)
- ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧: cod roe (salted, in a sac)
- ⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧: spicy seasoned cod roe
- ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧: herring roe (crunchy, eaten at New Year)
- ⟦とびこ→とびこ：30538_tobiko⟧: flying fish roe (small, used on sushi)
- {筋子|すじこ}: salmon roe still in the egg sac

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚卵|ぎょらん}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: fish roe allergy
- {魚卵|ぎょらん}⟦{加工品|かこうひん}→加工品：16489_kakouhin⟧: processed fish roe products
- {生|なま}{魚卵|ぎょらん}: raw fish roe

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fish roe is an important part of Japanese cuisine, especially for sushi, rice toppings, and New Year dishes (⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧ symbolizes fertility). Japan is one of the largest consumers of fish roe in the world.

REGISTER:
More formal than the specific names. In everyday conversation, people typically use the individual names (いくら, ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧, etc.) rather than {魚卵|ぎょらん}.
